story: The sound of the dialup, pictured (2012)
text: 3d spectrogram: [LINK] Animation of the picture illustrated in this article: [VIDEO] If you live with someone >= 30, turn up the volume and wait for him/her to appear at the door for a nostalgia moment...

I like this explanatory graphic (after many many years of listening to the dialup sounds) - [LINK] And this version combining the graphic and the sound used to make the graphic: [VIDEO] And this alternative version (h/t @Kye): [LINK]
The dial tone was prior to dialing. Upon connection, there was an audible sound from the modem handshake. Through some google searches, I came across this recording: [VIDEO]
